title: isn't haven't don't etc. (negatives)
summary: Как делать отрицание: **not (n't)** после вспомогательных и модальных глаголов, **don't / doesn't / didn't** — для остальных глаголов.
ru:
## Общее правило: добавляем not
Отрицание строится с помощью **not** (в речи **n't**).
> I'm not tired. — Я не устал.
> It isn't raining. — Дождя нет.
> They aren't here. — Их здесь нет.
> I haven't finished. — Я не закончил.
> She can't swim. — Она не умеет плавать.
> We won't be late. — Мы не опоздаем.

## Таблица форм
| Утвердительная | Отрицательная |
|---|---|
| am | am not (**'m not**) |
| is | is not (**isn't**) |
| are | are not (**aren't**) |
| was | **wasn't** |
| were | **weren't** |
| have / has | **haven't / hasn't** |
| will | **won't** |
| can | **can't** (cannot) |
| could | **couldn't** |
| must | **mustn't** |
| should | **shouldn't** |
| would | **wouldn't** |

## Остальные глаголы: don't / doesn't / didn't
У обычных глаголов (work, like, go ...) нужен вспомогательный **do**.
- настоящее: **don't** (I/we/you/they) и **doesn't** (he/she/it)
- прошедшее: **didn't** (все лица)
После них — глагол в **начальной форме**.
> I don't like fish. — Я не люблю рыбу.
> She doesn't work on Sundays. — Она не работает по воскресеньям.
> We didn't go out yesterday. — Вчера мы не выходили.

## Для чего нужно do
Глаголы **be, can, will, must, should, have got** сами образуют отрицание. **Do** к ним не нужен.
> ~~I don't am tired.~~ → I'm not tired.
> ~~She doesn't can swim.~~ → She can't swim.
> ~~He doesn't has a car.~~ → He doesn't **have** a car. / He hasn't got a car.

## Особенности
- нет **amn't**: говорим **I'm not**;
- в английском **только одно** отрицание: ~~I don't know nothing.~~ → I don't know **anything**. / I know **nothing**.
- в русском отрицание «не / ни» может быть двойным, в английском нет.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She not likes it.~~ → She **doesn't** like it.
- ~~He doesn't likes it.~~ → He doesn't **like** it.
- ~~I didn't went.~~ → I didn't **go**.
- ~~They don't are ready.~~ → They **aren't** ready.
- ~~I don't have no time.~~ → I don't have **any** time.
en:
## The basic rule: add not
We make negatives with **not** (**n't** in speaking).
> I'm not tired.
> It isn't raining.
> They aren't here.
> I haven't finished.
> She can't swim.
> We won't be late.

## Table of forms
| Positive | Negative |
|---|---|
| am | am not (**'m not**) |
| is | is not (**isn't**) |
| are | are not (**aren't**) |
| was | **wasn't** |
| were | **weren't** |
| have / has | **haven't / hasn't** |
| will | **won't** |
| can | **can't** (cannot) |
| could | **couldn't** |
| must | **mustn't** |
| should | **shouldn't** |
| would | **wouldn't** |

## Other verbs: don't / doesn't / didn't
With ordinary verbs (work, like, go ...) we use **do**.
- present: **don't** (I/we/you/they) and **doesn't** (he/she/it)
- past: **didn't** (all persons)
After them we use the **base form** of the verb.
> I don't like fish.
> She doesn't work on Sundays.
> We didn't go out yesterday.

## When we don't need do
With **be, can, will, must, should, have got** we don't use **do**.
> ~~I don't am tired.~~ → I'm not tired.
> ~~She doesn't can swim.~~ → She can't swim.

## Notes
- there is no **amn't**: say **I'm not**;
- in English we use only **one** negative: ~~I don't know nothing.~~ → I don't know **anything**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She not likes it.~~ → She **doesn't** like it.
- ~~He doesn't likes it.~~ → He doesn't **like** it.
- ~~I didn't went.~~ → I didn't **go**.
- ~~I don't have no time.~~ → I don't have **any** time.
structure:
## Be и модальные глаголы
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| I am | I'm not | I'm not ready. |
| he is | he isn't | He isn't at home. |
| they are | they aren't | They aren't tired. |
| it was | it wasn't | It wasn't cold. |
| you can | you can't | You can't park here. |
| I will | I won't | I won't be late. |

## Остальные глаголы
| Время | Подлежащее | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|
| Настоящее | I / we / you / they | don't + глагол | We don't work here. |
| Настоящее | he / she / it | doesn't + глагол | She doesn't smoke. |
| Прошедшее | все | didn't + глагол | I didn't see him. |

## Формулы
> Подлежащее + **am/is/are/was/were/can/will... + not** + ...
> Подлежащее + **don't / doesn't / didn't** + глагол в начальной форме

## Запомните
- **I'm not** (не ~~amn't~~);
- после **don't / doesn't / didn't** — всегда начальная форма (не ~~likes~~, не ~~went~~);
- в английском предложении только **одно** отрицание.

exercises.title: Сделайте отрицание
exercises.instruction: Поставьте предложение в отрицание (используйте краткие формы).

items.text: She works on Sundays. → She {{doesn't work|does not work}} on Sundays.
They are at home. → They {{aren't|are not|'re not}} at home.
I like cold weather. → I {{don't like|do not like}} cold weather.
We went to the park. → We {{didn't go|did not go}} to the park.
The shops were open. → The shops {{weren't|were not}} open.
